name: Gebeya Dala Studio
description: Pan-African AI studio for building apps, AI agents, games, video, images and music from prompts; pay-as-you-go credits payable by mobile money.
research_notes: Network in this session blocked the publisher's site (curl and WebFetch both refused), so nothing here was read on the page itself: every fact comes from WebSearch result snippets of the publisher's own pages, cited to the result URL. Marked candidate for that reason; re-verify by fetching before marking verified. Payment list from the dala.gebeya.com homepage snippet: M-Pesa, Telebirr, CBE Birr, Awash Birr, Airtel Money, MTN MoMo, Chapa, Flutterwave, Paystack, ArifPay, Stripe or cards. Gateways (Chapa, Flutterwave, Paystack, ArifPay, Stripe) are not listed as methods on their own (BUSINESS-RULES 10); CBE Birr and Awash Birr are bank wallets, put under bank_transfer. Which wallet works in which country is not stated. Credits: one shared balance, no subscription required, one-off top-ups from about $1, offers priced in USD; teams page says pay-as-you-go in local currency with a minimum credit purchase. Docs (older) say beta with a freemium tier and no card needed to start, so free = free_tier from the docs. M-Pesa Ethiopia and Gebeya launched a "Dala AI Bundle" (Feb-Mar 2026, press release on Zawya, itweb) letting Ethiopians subscribe from the M-Pesa wallet; bundle prices not published. Categories: coding (app builder), image, video, music. Interface languages and publisher registration not found. Verification review 2026-11-16: compared with the official pages fetched that day (4 pages); 15 quoted confirmations, corrected or added: access.free, access.free_limits, access.signup_requirements. The docs page cited for the free tier and 'no card needed' didn't load, so free status and sign-up now cite the live pages ('limited free credits', 'one account'). 'No card needed' is dropped as unconfirmed. Payment methods are all named on the homepage. The '(Ethiopia)' in the CBE/Awash note isn't stated there; Stripe, Chapa, Flutterwave, Paystack and ArifPay are processors and aren't listed.

access.free_limits: Limited free credits to try the tools (free and promotional credits expire); after that, prepaid pay-as-you-go credits from US$1, no subscription required.
